facts.text: The package wraps Thorlabs' APT.dll shared library
The package only works on Windows because it is based on APT.dll
The README lists K10CR1, LTS150 and other motors as reported working devices and says the package should work with all motors supported by APT
Motor(serial_number) stores the serial number and calls InitHWDevice(serial_number) in its constructor
move_to(value, blocking=False) sends MOT_MoveAbsoluteEx and move_by(value, blocking=False) sends MOT_MoveRelativeEx
move_home(blocking=False) sends MOT_MoveHome
move_velocity(direction) sends MOT_MoveVelocity
MOVE_FWD is 1 and MOVE_REV is 2
stop_profiled() sends MOT_StopProfiled
position reads MOT_GetPosition
get_stage_axis_info returns (minimum position, maximum position, stage units, pitch); the stage units are STAGE_UNITS_MM = 1 and STAGE_UNITS_DEG = 2

get_hardware_limit_switches returns reverse and forward modes; HWLIMSWITCH_IGNORE = 1, HWLIMSWITCH_MAKES = 2, HWLIMSWITCH_BREAKS = 3, HWLIMSWITCH_MAKES_HOMEONLY = 4 and HWLIMSWITCH_BREAKS_HOMEONLY = 5
set_hardware_limit_switches(rev, fwd) sends MOT_SetHWLimSwitches
get_move_home_parameters returns (direction, limiting switch, velocity, zero offset)
HOME_FWD is 1, HOME_REV is 2, HOMELIMSW_FWD is 4 and HOMELIMSW_REV is 1
get_velocity_parameters returns (minimum velocity, acceleration, maximum velocity)
set_velocity_parameters(min_vel, accn, max_vel) sends MOT_SetVelParams; the docstring says the minimum velocity is always 0 and is ignored
get_velocity_parameter_limits returns the maximum acceleration and the maximum velocity of the motor
is_in_motion is derived from status bits 0x00000010, 0x00000020, 0x00000040, 0x00000080 and 0x00000200
is_channel_enabled uses status bit 0x80000000; enable() and disable() send MOT_EnableHWChannel and MOT_DisableHWChannel
has_homing_been_completed uses status bit 0x00000400, is_settled uses 0x00002000 and motion_error uses 0x00004000
active_channel is 0 for channel 1 and 1 for channel 2

operator_required.name: velocity_maximum
operator_required.reason: the maximum velocity depends on the motor and stage: the clone returns it at run time from MOT_GetVelParamLimits (thorlabs_apt/core.py:395-418) and states no fixed number; the operator supplies the site limit

operator_required.name: acceleration
operator_required.reason: the maximum acceleration depends on the motor and stage: the clone returns it at run time from MOT_GetVelParamLimits (thorlabs_apt/core.py:395-418) and states no fixed number; the operator supplies the site limit

operator_required.name: move_to
operator_required.reason: the travel range of the installed stage is not stated in the clone; get_stage_axis_info reads it from the controller at run time (thorlabs_apt/core.py:574-597), so the operator supplies the range

operator_required.name: move_by
operator_required.reason: the travel range of the installed stage is not stated in the clone; get_stage_axis_info reads it from the controller at run time (thorlabs_apt/core.py:574-597), so the operator supplies the range

safe_state.description: motor stopped with the native profiled stop (MOT_StopProfiled); the channel stays enabled unless disable is called
